claims.text:
Ufedhin is a Gnomish word meaning "outcast, outlaw" or "one who changes his clan and goes to a new kinship".
Category:Characters in The Book of Lost Tales
Category:Gnomes
Category:Gnomish names

claims.text: In the end, when Beren's army annihilated the Dwarves and Beren himself slew Naugladur, Ufedhin saw Gwendelin for the final time. He could not endure the sight of her, and fled screaming in pain and terror. None knew what became of him after this.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, Christopher Tolkien (ed.), The Book of Lost Tales Part Two, "IV. The Nauglafring"
